description:
Get the status, page progress, sample verdict, RUB billing, QC summary and signed download URLs of one book.

status lifecycle: splitting -> ready -> (optional sampling -> sampled) -> processing -> done (or failed).
When status is done and qc.passed is true, files carries signed 24h HTTPS links for epub, fb2, docx, pdf
(searchable scan + verified text layer), optional pdf_clean (typeset clean PDF), md, report_json and report_html.
Only offer formats present in files. If qc.passed is false, package downloads
stay closed while the team reviews the book and only report_json / report_html are exposed.
name: get_book
